title: Answer: integrated information as self-model evidence, meaning as a difference that matters

statements.text: Information is Bayesian belief in a generative model. Integrated information may correspond to self-model evidence in the sense of FEP-AI, a special measure of dynamical complexity, and meaning is a difference that makes a difference to a system pursuing its goals.

sources.quote: If integrated information corresponds to self-model-evidence as described by FEP-AI, then this would be a very special measure of dynamical complexity
